name: Tidewrought
descriptionSeed: A city of hulls lashed together on the open ocean, never in the same place twice. It trades along every coast the world has, and every season some ship comes into a harbour that says the Tidewrought sent it.
encounterFlavor: saltfolk sailors, ocean traders, and people who came aboard to get somewhere and never got off
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: pinned at the LANDING where a traveller reaches them, which is also the region's seat on land. The city of lashed hulls rides at anchor off this shore; boats run out to it.
appearance: Hundreds of hulls lashed into one floating town, masts like a forest, rope bridges between decks, and a market on the biggest deck that never closes.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
